comparison.objective: Tighten a tourniquet windlass to a pressure threshold and snap-lock it; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Torque-producing windlass rotation with handover/regrasp, state monitoring and snap insertion against rollback versus load-shared sifting and controlled loose-body dynamics.
comparison.success_condition: Gauge ≥250 mmHg, rod mechanically locked and hands clear for 1 second versus ≥98% recovery, complete washer retention, screen support and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: The record tests sustained rotational tensioning and latch capture, not selective passage through apertures; shared bimanual coordination is generic.
